issue_context.title: [Run] Add options to run commands from different shells (in Settings or at runtime)
issue_context.body:
**EDIT:** Settings are one aspect of this feature, also see https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/9627 for a way to select different shells at runtime. We need to make sure the UX is consistent between settings and runtime.

---

Add settings to select default shell and terminal which will affect PowerToys Run. It should also detect third-party terminals as suggested in [the spec](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/wiki/Launcher#212-settings):

11 | Users   can see third-party terminals in the dropdown list for default terminal | 3
-- | -- | --




![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8364748/84534735-54c20380-ac9f-11ea-8d3a-c94d5716f4b2.png)
